author: lapiderriere
body:
As a fellow stubborn RS, I think that when they call it "endgame" content, it means we should just stop playing. 😭

edit - I've been realm raider forever, but have tried assassin lately.  

I may try aggravating donkey's suggestion next time I find a tower that is not in a jungle...

author: Aggravating-Donkey19
body: What ascension level are you? When I do towers I run cataphract to get the extra defense and ward recovery currently at 108k ward

author: Jemmo1
body:
As RS lv.237, AL17: 5k att, 4.7k def/res, 66%crit

I cast Ward of Ortanite, Wyrm's Song & just Sortie it all till it's all dead (excluding the mid and end boss).
No redlining, just crit & heal lol

It works for me, i reached several lv.40 floors but not past 45 yet, as i just run towers when i see them around my area.

I hope it helps

author: weirdplacetogoonfire
body: I rushed RS Dorado and don't have any regrets. It made tower performance wayyyy more consistent. I can pretty reliably finish off a 50 floor tower, albeit a lot slower and I have to be much more picky about fights than other classes. It was a crapshoot whether I could make it through tougher forced battles as base RS. Still not as good as most other classes, but if you want to stick with RS that's what I would recommend.

author: Makko69
body:
I usually go with Zwei-Fencer for specialization and APhoenix as follower.
For the equipment i use 100% ONC, 196% AHel garb and 186% ARiftrogue boots, my main weapon are 186% Realmspikes since mine have 43% critical chance, also i use briny pendal and Anwnn ring.
I have around 50K ward like this, and i managed to clear a 47 floors Selene tower with it!
